newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour's Blair pledges to meet inflation target.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour's Blair pledges to meet inflation target.

text.p: British Labour Party leader Tony Blair said on Thursday that a Labour government would meet the inflation targets it had set itself.

Asked what Labour would do in response to calls from the International Monetary Fund and the Confederation of British Industry for monetary and/or fiscal tightening to cool domestic demand, Blair refused to specify policy but pledged to meet the Party's 2.5 percent inflation target.

"We will make sure those targets are met," Blair told a news conference. Shadow Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown has adopted the ruling Conservatives' target of 2.5 percent or less for underlying inflation.
